review_method: Inspected saved isometric, plan, swing-link closeup and explicitly display-cut keyway view against reviewed SNL6/HB92 arrangement and catalogue identities.
findings: Both clutch swing connections are below the pivot; distinct short/long links retain actual axial Woodruff shaft/hub engagement.
Four complete through-floor bolt/lock/nut mounts and two complete clamp sets follow printed bolt lengths. Floor6 mount and tall twin-cheek profile are hypotheses.
M581 uses different source fork/pin families at its ends. Estimated upward departure and outboard bend clear actual carrier, stop rod, flywheel, engine support and high control.
No whole-length camera fit across broken source rods. Manufacturing and motion remain unqualified.
No15 height10.31mm remains estimated; modern one-inch/quarter-inch correspondence alone is not historical dimension proof.
